children: According to CNBC, President Donald Trump cast his midterm-election ballot early in Florida on Saturday, saying he voted for all Republicans in the state before speaking at a Georgia rally. Trump and first lady Melania Trump arrived at the Palm Beach County Supervisor of Elections office in West Palm Beach, where he voted.

title: Trump Casts Midterm Election Ballot Early in Florida
